The vendor and developer directly providing **Aposting** at **aposting.com** is independent developer **Samuel Whitehall**. No formal corporate entity is published for the platform.

### Supporting Evidence:
* **Product / Domain:** Aposting (`aposting.com`).
* **Developer Statement:** In a public release announcement on Hacker News (*Show HN: I Built an AI to Auto-Write LinkedIn Posts (aposting.com)*), developer Samuel Whitehall announced:
  > *"Hey HN, I built an AI that automates LinkedIn content creation—from generating post ideas to writing full posts in seconds... Try it here: https://aposting.com."*
  > *"I built this tool to make LinkedIn posting effortless, but I know it's not perfect yet."*
